commentary.message: Kickoff at Santiago Bernabéu — Real Madrid in white, Barcelona in blue and red.
Vinícius Jr. cuts inside from the left and fires a shot from the edge of the box.
Brilliant diving save by ter Stegen to deny Vinícius Jr.
Tchouaméni clips Pedri from behind — Barcelona win a free kick in midfield.
Yellow card shown to Tchouaméni for the late challenge.
GOAL! Lewandowski finishes a precise cross from Raphinha — Barcelona take the lead.
Rodrygo's cross is deflected behind — corner to Real Madrid.
GOAL! Bellingham rises highest from the corner and heads it into the net — Real Madrid equalize!
Halftime whistle — Real Madrid 1, Barcelona 1.
Kickoff at the Etihad Stadium — Manchester City in sky blue, Liverpool in red.
Haaland powers a shot from inside the box after a quick pass from De Bruyne.
Alisson reacts quickly and makes a strong save to deny Haaland.
GOAL! Salah breaks through the defense and calmly slots the ball past Ederson.
Rodri brings down Mac Allister in midfield — free kick to Liverpool.
Rodri receives a yellow card for the late challenge.
GOAL! Haaland finishes a perfect through ball from De Bruyne — City equalize.
Foden's cross is deflected behind by Van Dijk — corner for Manchester City.
Halftime whistle — Manchester City 1, Liverpool 1.
Kickoff at Allianz Arena — Bayern Munich in red, Borussia Dortmund in yellow and black.
Kane strikes from just outside the box after a quick pass from Musiala.
Kobel makes a strong save diving to his left to deny Kane.
GOAL! Musiala dribbles past two defenders and finishes neatly into the bottom corner.
Emre Can brings down Sané near the touchline — free kick to Bayern.
Yellow card shown to Emre Can for the late tackle.
GOAL! Füllkrug heads home a brilliant cross from Brandt — Dortmund equalize.
Halftime whistle — Bayern Munich 1, Borussia Dortmund 1.
Kickoff at Parc des Princes — PSG in navy blue, Marseille in white.
Mbappé bursts past the defender and unleashes a quick shot from inside the box.
Great reflex save by Pau López to keep Mbappé's effort out.
GOAL! Mbappé finishes a low cross from Hakimi — PSG take the lead.
Marquinhos commits a foul on Aubameyang near the midfield circle.
Yellow card shown to Marquinhos for stopping the counterattack.
GOAL! Aubameyang taps it in after a rebound inside the six-yard box.
Dembélé's cross is deflected by the defender — corner to PSG.
Halftime whistle — Paris Saint-Germain 1, Marseille 1.
Kickoff at Allianz Stadium — Juventus in black and white, AC Milan in red and black.
Leão cuts inside from the left and curls a shot toward the far post.
Szczęsny stretches to his right and makes a fantastic save to deny Leão.
Rabiot brings down Pulisic near the halfway line — free kick for Milan.
Yellow card shown to Rabiot for the late challenge.
Chiesa's cross is deflected by Tomori — Juventus win a corner.
GOAL! Vlahović rises above the defenders and heads the ball into the net from the corner.
Giroud puts the ball in the net but the flag goes up — offside.
Halftime whistle — Juventus 1, AC Milan 0.
Match on — India to bat first at the venue. Umpires on the field.
Rohit nudges into the covers — quick single.
FOUR! Gill drills it through extra cover — lovely timing.
CAUGHT AT SLIP — Rohit Sharma departs after an edge to first slip.
WIDE! Down the leg side — one extra to the batting side.
NO-BALL! Overstep from Starc — free hit to follow.
SIX! Iyer clears long-off — enormous hit, up and over.
BOWLED! Middle stump uprooted — crucial wicket for Australia.
India finish on 312/8 (50 overs) — competitive total posted.
Play begins — England open the batting while Pakistan take the field.
FOUR! Bairstow punches it through point — first boundary of the innings.
WIDE! Afridi strays down the leg side — easy extra for England.
SIX! Buttler launches it over long-on — huge strike into the crowd.
CAUGHT! Bairstow edges behind — Pakistan strike with an important wicket.
Root works it into the gap at midwicket — comfortable two runs.
NO-BALL! Afridi oversteps — free hit coming up.
FOUR! Stokes smashes it through long-off — powerful strike.
England finish on 285/9 after 50 overs — Pakistan need 286 to win.
We are underway — South Africa begin their innings against New Zealand.
De Kock taps it into the off side and gets off the mark with a single.
FOUR! Hendricks cuts hard through point.
Wide from Boult — strays well outside off stump.
SIX! De Kock pulls it over deep midwicket.
OUT! Hendricks edges to the keeper — New Zealand get the breakthrough.
Markram flicks to square leg for a comfortable two.
FOUR! De Kock drives beautifully down the ground.
No-ball! Henry oversteps — free hit coming.
FREE HIT SIX! De Kock sends it into the stands.
Markram nudges it into midwicket for a single.
BOWLED! Santner beats Markram with spin.
FOUR! Klaasen sweeps hard to the boundary.
Miller pushes to long-on and collects two.
SIX! Miller launches it straight over the bowler.
OUT! Klaasen caught at deep cover.
Miller works it behind square for one.
FOUR! Jansen edges it past the keeper.
Single to end the innings — South Africa close strongly.
South Africa finish with 301/7 in 50 overs — New Zealand will chase 302.
We are ready to begin — India start their innings against Pakistan.
Rohit taps it gently into the off side and gets off the mark with a single.
FOUR! Kohli drives it elegantly through covers.
Wide down the leg side — Shaheen will need to correct his line.
SIX! Rohit launches it over long-on — trademark hit.
OUT! Rohit edges it behind — Pakistan strike early.
Gill nudges it to midwicket and takes a quick single.
FOUR! Kohli sweeps it beautifully to the boundary.
No-ball! Shaheen oversteps — free hit coming.
FREE HIT SIX! Kohli smashes it into the stands.
Gill rotates strike with a single to long-off.
BOWLED! Shadab gets one through — Kohli is gone.
FOUR! Rahul guides it fine past third man.
Hardik punches it into the gap and picks up two runs.
SIX! Hardik clears long-off with brute force.
OUT! Hardik holes out to deep midwicket.
Jadeja taps it for a quick single.
FOUR! Rahul cuts it past backward point.
Single to finish — India post a competitive total.
India finish with 284/7 in 50 overs — Pakistan need 285 to win.
Game on — Australia begin their innings against England.
Warner pushes into the off side and takes a quick single.
FOUR! Head times the cover drive perfectly.
Wide from Archer — that flies outside off.
SIX! Warner smashes it over midwicket.
OUT! Warner skies it — taken safely at mid-off.
Head clips it off the pads and runs two.
FOUR! Smith cuts it late past backward point.
No-ball! Archer oversteps — free hit coming.
FREE HIT SIX! Head launches it over long-on.
Smith rotates strike with a calm single.
BOWLED! Rashid deceives Smith in flight — big wicket.
FOUR! Labuschagne drives through extra cover.
Two runs taken with a well-timed pull shot.
SIX! Maxwell clears the ropes with ease.
OUT! Maxwell holes out to the deep.
Carey nudges it to third man for a single.
FOUR! Cummins edges it fine past the keeper.
Single taken — Australia wrap up their innings.
Australia finish on 272/8 in 50 overs — England need 273 to win.
